s: This article details the process of migrating a Jupyter Notebook-based SEO workflow into the Pipulate framework, focusing on environment setup, Git integration with nbstripout, and simplifying application structure for efficient automation and reduced cognitive load.
sub: Setting up a shared Python virtual environment with Pipulate and JupyterLab.
Utilizing nbstripout to clean Git diffs for Jupyter Notebooks.
Implementing nested Git repositories with a `.gitignore` for private client work.
Simplifying path management in local-first applications by co-locating data.
Leveraging Nix for environment management and shared dependencies.
